chunks: Is it possible that if placed in authority you will create disorder in the land and sever your bonds of relationship?

key_terms.تَوَلَّيْتُمْ: You took charge / were placed in authority

ai.seo_question: What are the signs of corruption when believers are in authority?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as a warning against the corruption of leadership, where those entrusted with authority may exploit their position to disrupt social order and sever familial bonds, reflecting the concept of *fasad* (corruption). It underscores the dual responsibility of believers to maintain both vertical spiritual integrity and horizontal social cohesion, particularly emphasizing the preservation of *silat al-rahim* (kinship ties) as a cornerstone of communal stability.
